proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.planeOverride
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation family and charge-cast spell grant can represent the cube's charges, dawn recharge, and Magic action activation, but there is no honest way to express that pressing a given cube face constrains the granted Gate or Plane Shift cast to the plane keyed to that face.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Pressing one side of the cube, you cast Gate, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side."

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.planeOverride
proposed_widenings.justification: The same missing shape is required for the second spell mode: the destination plane is not freely chosen at cast time, but inherited from the selected cube face.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast Plane Shift, transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side."

notes: Did not author content/magic_item_cubic_gate.dhall. A placeholder grant_spell_access to gate or plane_shift would omit the cube's core keyed-plane mechanic and produce a misleading trace.
